eventDetail.scope: The 17th IEEE International Conference on RFID Technology and Applications (IEEE RFID-TA 2027) is a flagship global event for researchers, engineers, and industry professionals engaged in Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and its broad landscape of technologies and applications. This year, the conference will be hosted at Kuala Lumpur. RFID-TA 2026 will feature a dynamic Technical Program showcasing breakthroughs in areas such as chipless RFID, AI for RFID, energy harvesting, secure systems, localization, and the rapidly growing ecosystem of RFID-enabled IoT and sensing. The event will offer a wide spectrum of technical sessions, interactive panels, tutorials, workshops, and industry-focused demos, creating a space for both academic excellence and practical innovation.
